verdict.rationale: The only explicit multi-item operation is the Dashboard export of all or a filtered subset of invoices to CSV, plus a cross-account invoice list under Organizations. Bulk actions otherwise depend on scripting loops over the Invoicing API, official libraries, CLI or MCP server, which enable automation but do not document bulk endpoints. Missing for 10: documented bulk write actions (bulk create/finalize/send/void), batch API endpoints, bulk operations via MCP/CLI, independent hands-on corroboration.
